scripts.docker:dev: npm run docker:volumes:ensure:dev && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.docker:dev:fresh-deps: npm run docker:volumes:ensure:dev && docker rm -f shuttlementor-app-dev 2>/dev/null || true && docker volume prune -f --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shuttlementor-dev 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache app && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.docker:dev:redeploy: export BUILD_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" && npm run docker:logs:snapshot:dev && npm run docker:dev:stop && docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && docker container prune --filter until=168h -f && docker builder prune --keep-storage 12G -f && npm run docker:dev
scripts.docker:dev:redeploy:up: npm run docker:volumes:ensure:dev && npm run docker:logs:snapshot:dev && npm run docker:dev:stop && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.docker:dev:redeploy:cleanup: docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && docker container prune --filter until=168h -f && docker builder prune --keep-storage 12G -f && (npm run docker:volumes:prune:dev || true)
scripts.docker:dev:redeploy:detached: npm run docker:dev:build && npm run docker:dev:redeploy:up && npm run docker:dev:redeploy:cleanup
scripts.docker:prod: npm run docker:volumes:ensure:prod && export $(grep -v '^#' .env.production | xargs) && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.docker:prod:redeploy: export BUILD_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" && npm run docker:logs:snapshot:prod && npm run docker:prod:stop && docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && docker container prune --filter until=168h -f && docker builder prune --keep-storage 12G -f && npm run docker:prod
scripts.docker:prod:build: export $(grep -v '^#' .env.production | xargs) && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml build
scripts.docker:prod:redeploy:up: npm run docker:volumes:ensure:prod && export $(grep -v '^#' .env.production | xargs) && npm run docker:logs:snapshot:prod && npm run docker:prod:stop && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.docker:prod:redeploy:cleanup: docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && docker container prune --filter until=168h -f && docker builder prune --keep-storage 12G -f && (npm run docker:volumes:prune:prod || true)
scripts.docker:prod:redeploy:detached: npm run docker:prod:build && npm run docker:prod:redeploy:up && npm run docker:prod:redeploy:cleanup
scripts.docker:images:prune:all: docker image prune -a -f && docker builder prune -f
scripts.docker:volumes:prune:prod: sh -c 'for name in shuttlementor-app-prod shuttlementor-db-prod; do docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -qx "$name" || { echo "Refusing to prune: expected running container $name"; exit 1; }; done; volumes=$(docker volume ls -q --filter dangling=true --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shuttlementor-prod | sort -u); if [ -z "$volumes" ]; then echo "No unused prod volumes to prune"; exit 0; fi; printf "%s\n" "$volumes" | xargs docker volume rm'
scripts.docker:volumes:prune:all: npm run docker:volumes:prune:dev && npm run docker:volumes:prune:prod
scripts.docker:db:migrate:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:db:migrate:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:db:studio:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npx prisma studio --port 5555
scripts.docker:db:studio:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app npx prisma studio --port 5556
scripts.check-stripe-fence: test "$(grep -rlE --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' "from ['\"]stripe['\"]" src/ | grep -v 'src/server/services/payments/stripe.ts' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = '0' || (echo 'Stripe SDK import outside src/server/services/payments/stripe.ts'; exit 1)
scripts.//prepare: GUARD: `2>/dev/null || true` is required, not cruft. npm runs `prepare` during `npm ci` in the Docker build (Dockerfile), where .git — and usually the git binary — is absent, so an unguarded `git config` would fail and break the image build. The guard makes it a harmless no-op there; locally it activates the committed pre-push gate via core.hooksPath=.githooks. Do not remove the guard.
